sentences.en: Excuse me, how much is this?
sentences.fr: Excusez-moi, c’est combien?

sentences.en: That one is 15,000 won!
sentences.fr: Celui-ci coûte 15 000 wons!

sentences.en: Oh, that’s better than I expected. Can I get a discount?
sentences.es: Ah, no está tan mal. ¿Puede hacerme un pequeño descuento?
sentences.fr: Ah, ce n’est pas si cher. Vous pouvez faire une petite réduction?
sentences.pt: Ah, não é assim tão caro. Pode fazer algum desconto?

sentences.target: 지금은 천 원 정도만 깎아드릴 수 있어요.
sentences.en: I can give you a small discount—about 1,000 won off.
sentences.fr: Je peux baisser un peu—environ 1 000 wons.
sentences.pt: Posso baixar um pouco—cerca de 1 000 wons.

sentences.en: Great! I’ll take it at that price.
sentences.fr: Super! Je le prends à ce prix-là.
sentences.pt: Ótimo! Fico com isto a esse preço.

sentences.en: Sure, I’ll ring it up for you!
sentences.fr: Très bien, je passe à la caisse pour vous!

sentences.target: 이 모자 예쁘네요. 가격이 어떻게 돼요?
sentences.en: This hat looks nice. How much is it?
sentences.es: Este sombrero se ve bonito. ¿Cuánto cuesta?
sentences.fr: Ce chapeau est joli. Il coûte combien?
sentences.pt: Este chapéu é giro. Quanto é?

sentences.en: That hat is 20,000 won.
sentences.fr: Ce chapeau coûte 20 000 wons.

sentences.target: 음… 조금 비싸네요. 다른 색도 있어요?
sentences.en: Hmm… it's a bit pricey. Do you have other colors?
sentences.es: Hmm… es un poco caro. ¿Tiene otros colores?
sentences.fr: Hmm… c’est un peu cher. Vous avez d’autres couleurs?
sentences.pt: Hmm… é um bocadinho caro. Tem outras cores?

sentences.en: Yes! We have it in blue and black.
sentences.es: Sí, lo tenemos en azul y negro.
sentences.fr: Oui! Nous l’avons en bleu et en noir.
sentences.pt: Sim! Temos em azul e preto.

sentences.en: Then I’ll go with the blue one!
sentences.fr: Alors je prends le bleu!

sentences.en: Great, I'll bring the blue one for you.
sentences.fr: Parfait, je vous apporte le bleu.

sentences.en: How much is this drink?
sentences.fr: Cette boisson, elle coûte combien?

sentences.en: The regular size is 4,000 won.
sentences.fr: La taille normale est à 4 000 wons.

sentences.en: Oh! That’s not bad. Can I change the size?
sentences.fr: Oh! Pas mal. Je peux changer de taille?
sentences.pt: Ah! Nada mau. Posso mudar o tamanho?

sentences.en: Yes, a large is 1,000 won extra.
sentences.es: Sí, la grande cuesta 1.000 won más.
sentences.fr: Oui, la grande coûte 1 000 wons de plus.
sentences.pt: Sim, o grande custa mais 1 000 wons.

sentences.en: Then I’ll take a large, please!
sentences.fr: Alors je prends une grande, s’il vous plaît!
sentences.pt: Então quero o tamanho grande, por favor.

sentences.en: Alright, I’ll make it a large!
sentences.fr: Très bien, je vous prépare une grande!

sentences.en: How much are these if I buy two?
sentences.fr: Et si j’en prends deux, ça fait combien?

sentences.en: Two of them would be 10,000 won.
sentences.fr: Les deux font 10 000 wons.

sentences.en: Oh, that’s cheaper than I expected!
sentences.es: Oh, ¡es más barato de lo que pensaba!
sentences.fr: Oh, c’est moins cher que je pensais!
sentences.pt: Oh, é mais barato do que pensei!

sentences.en: They’re on sale right now, so the price is lower.
sentences.es: Están en oferta ahora, así que salen más baratos.
sentences.fr: C’est en promotion en ce moment, donc c’est moins cher.
sentences.pt: Estão em promoção agora, por isso sai mais barato.

sentences.en: Okay, I’ll take both.
sentences.es: De acuerdo, me llevo los dos.
sentences.fr: D’accord, je prends les deux.

sentences.en: Sure, I’ll pack them for you!
sentences.fr: Très bien, je vous emballe tout ça!

sentences.target: 혹시 이거 더 작은 사이즈도 있나요?
sentences.en: Do you have a smaller size?
sentences.fr: Vous avez une taille plus petite?

sentences.en: Yes, we do have a smaller size.
sentences.es: Sí, tenemos una talla más pequeña.
sentences.fr: Oui, nous avons une taille plus petite.
sentences.pt: Sim, temos um tamanho mais pequeno.

sentences.en: Nice! Is there any price difference?
sentences.fr: Super! Le prix change ou pas?

sentences.en: The price is the same!
sentences.fr: Le prix est le même!

sentences.en: Then I’ll take the smaller one.
sentences.fr: Alors je prends la petite.

sentences.en: Okay, I’ll get the smaller one for you.
sentences.es: Muy bien, le traigo la pequeña.
sentences.fr: Très bien, je vous apporte la petite.
sentences.pt: Muito bem, já trago o pequeno.

sentences.target: 저… 여기서 제일 싼 물건이 뭐예요?
sentences.en: Um… what’s the cheapest item here?
sentences.es: Eh… ¿cuál es el artículo más barato aquí?
sentences.fr: Euh… quel est l’article le moins cher ici?
sentences.pt: Hum… qual é o artigo mais barato aqui?

sentences.en: The cheapest one is this—it’s 3,000 won.
sentences.es: El más barato es este—cuesta 3.000 won.
sentences.fr: Le moins cher, c’est celui-ci—il est à 3 000 wons.
sentences.pt: O mais barato é este—custa 3 000 wons.

sentences.target: 오, 괜찮네요. 지금 바로 살 수 있어요?
sentences.en: Oh, that’s good. Can I buy it now?
sentences.fr: Ah, pas mal. Je peux l’acheter maintenant?

sentences.en: Yes, you can buy it right away!
sentences.fr: Oui, vous pouvez l’acheter tout de suite!

sentences.en: Great! I’ll take one.
sentences.fr: Super! J’en prends un.

sentences.en: Sure, I’ll get one ready for you.
sentences.es: Muy bien, preparo uno para usted.
sentences.fr: Très bien, je vous en prépare un.
sentences.pt: Muito bem, preparo um para si.

sentences.en: Do you accept card payments?
sentences.fr: Vous acceptez la carte?

sentences.en: Yes, we accept cards!
sentences.fr: Oui, nous acceptons la carte!

sentences.en: Oh, good. There’s no extra fee, right?
sentences.es: Ah, perfecto. No hay cargos extra, ¿verdad?
sentences.fr: Ah, parfait. Il n’y a pas de frais en plus, n’est-ce pas?
sentences.pt: Ótimo. Não há taxas adicionais, pois não?

sentences.en: Right, there’s no extra fee.
sentences.fr: Oui, sans frais supplémentaires.

sentences.en: Alright, I’ll pay by card.
sentences.fr: D’accord, je paie par carte.

sentences.en: Okay, I’ll process your payment!
sentences.fr: Très bien, je lance le paiement!
sentences.pt: Muito bem, vou processar o pagamento.

sentences.en: Is this brand new?
sentences.fr: C’est un produit neuf?

sentences.en: Yes, it’s completely new!
sentences.fr: Oui, c’est totalement neuf!

sentences.en: Nice! Is this the last one?
sentences.fr: Super! C’est le dernier?

sentences.en: Yes, this is the last one we have.
sentences.es: Sí, es el último que nos queda.
sentences.fr: Oui, c’est le tout dernier.
sentences.pt: Sim, é o último que temos.

sentences.en: Then I’ll buy it now.
sentences.fr: Alors je l’achète maintenant.

sentences.en: Alright! I’ll get it ready for you.
sentences.fr: Parfait, je vous prépare ça!

sentences.en: Is the price here correct?
sentences.es: ¿El precio que aparece aquí es correcto?
sentences.fr: Le prix indiqué est correct?

sentences.en: Yes, it used to be 18,000 won.
sentences.fr: Oui, avant il coûtait 18 000 wons.

sentences.en: Oh, it’s on sale?
sentences.fr: Ah, c’est en promotion?

sentences.en: But it’s on sale for 15,000 won right now!
sentences.es: Ahora está en oferta por 15.000 won.
sentences.fr: Maintenant il est en promotion à 15 000 wons!
sentences.pt: Agora está em promoção por 15 000 wons.

sentences.en: Then I guess it’s best to buy it now!
sentences.fr: Alors je ferais mieux de l’acheter maintenant!

sentences.en: That’s right—only until today!
sentences.fr: Exactement—seulement jusqu’à aujourd’hui!

sentences.en: How much is it with gift wrapping?
sentences.es: Con el envoltorio de regalo, ¿cuánto sería?
sentences.fr: Avec l’emballage cadeau, ça fait combien?
sentences.pt: Com embrulho de oferta, quanto fica?

sentences.en: With wrapping, it comes to 12,000 won.
sentences.fr: Avec l’emballage, ça fait 12 000 wons.
sentences.pt: Com o embrulho, fica por 12 000 wons.

sentences.en: Oh, the wrapping fee is cheaper than I thought!
sentences.es: Oh, la tarifa de envoltorio es más barata de lo que pensé.
sentences.fr: Oh, les frais d’emballage sont moins chers que je pensais!
sentences.pt: Ah, a taxa de embrulho é mais barata do que pensei.

sentences.en: Yes, the wrapping is only 1,000 won.
sentences.es: Sí, el envoltorio cuesta solo 1.000 won.
sentences.fr: Oui, l’emballage coûte seulement 1 000 wons.
sentences.pt: Sim, o embrulho custa apenas 1 000 wons.

sentences.en: Okay, please wrap it for me.
sentences.fr: D’accord, emballez-le s’il vous plaît.

sentences.en: Sure, I’ll wrap it nicely for you!
sentences.es: Muy bien, se lo envuelvo bonito.
sentences.fr: Très bien, je vous fais un bel emballage!
sentences.pt: Muito bem, faço um embrulho bonito.
